5.  24-52997  Recommendation to discuss holiday décor in the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Area Advisory Commission area for 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Tofani, seconded by Commissioner
  Meade, to approve recommendation, as amended, to preliminary approve up
  to $24,999 for the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area
  Advisory Commission to pay for the Belmont Shore Holiday Court on an
  annual bases, subject to review of the proposal. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  4  Blair, Kronick-Gath, Meade, Tofani
